in_sanskrit.name: Vibhorraj
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Power and Courage
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Vibhorraj एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Vibhorraj is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Vibh' meaning power and 'Raj' meaning rule. This name signifies the god of power and courage. It is believed that the bearer of this name will be blessed with strength, wisdom, and the ability to rule over others.
